bng.text: One-Eyed Pass is the mountain pass where an Akroan squad finds nine beheaded, butchered Akroans, including Captain Eumalos, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks.

Boulders then fall behind the squad, sealing the canyon, and a minotaur horde led by a huge sword-wielding brute charges them, so that Xanthos and Mnesos are killed and Haemon and Nikasios are struck down.
Kyrillos rams his sword into the minotaur leader and dies, and Pallas and Leandros behead the leader, so the surviving minotaurs scatter.
Diocles realizes the minotaurs lured and trapped the squad deliberately, and as Pallas, Diocles and Nikasios stay to hold off more minotaurs, Leandros climbs out to warn Akros.
